cache_policy: One fresh source load, no query warmup or cache flush; six blocks share evolving native caches. Every query covers all six method permutations and both acquisition directions at every paid-method position. This is a mixed-cache sequence, not isolated cold or controlled warm latency.
timing_scope: Prepared-plan method wall including both paid acquisition runs, selection, fresh final execution and online durable journal work. Shared validation/compilation/load, post-method summaries and block sealing separately recorded.
failure_policy: Stop all remaining actions/blocks on the first external failure, unknown cost, durability failure or finite budget; preserve all 48 x 6 x 3 slots. No retry or failed-answer substitution.

analysis_plan.primary_population: original32 seen-family queries; keep two exposed IDs annotated
secondary_populations: predeclared30 unexposed seen-family queries, sensitivity only
analysis_plan.unit: query; six repeated method runs aggregated to median wall per query/method
analysis_plan.primary_estimator: geometric mean of per-query median-wall ratios; smaller favors paid selection
analysis_plan.intervals: 97.5% percentile query-bootstrap interval per comparison (Bonferroni for two), stratified within the two fixed seen families; conditional on this workload, no unseen-family generalization
analysis_plan.cold_family: descriptive ratios/completion only, no transfer claim
other_outcomes: per-query paid choice and acquisition cost
analysis_plan.failures: No ratios for incomplete six-repeat pairs; retain all population denominators and report matched coverage. No population speedup claim if missing pairs.
